title: F-86s scrambled to chase objects away from Ellsworth's alert pad
place_text: Ellsworth AFB runway and alert pad, South Dakota

tellings.quote: uh what do they use f-86s at one point or a couple of times to chase these objects away and I think there's several reports of that

plain: At Ellsworth, an Air Force base in South Dakota, F-86 fighter jets were sent up at least once or twice to chase unknown objects away from the runway and the pad where alert aircraft stood ready. Mario Woods, a former nuclear base guard, says this, passing on what he heard from a man named Chris Leato and adding that he thinks there are several reports of it. It is told to show that the objects were seen as a real threat near nuclear forces.
